title: PAR-20/7G.3 RenderSettings root-alias refusal

finding.source: The RenderSettings graph validator counted the canonical ACAD_RENDER_PLOT_SETTINGS NOD root but did not reject a differently named NOD key targeting the same dictionary.
finding.risk: Ambiguous source ownership could be normalized during DXF export rather than refused as incomplete/ambiguous graph input.
finding.scope: RenderSettings export preflight only; this does not qualify every named-object-dictionary root family.

implementation: Extended the shared named-object-root validator with a required-root mode while preserving optional-root behavior for existing families.

RenderSettings validation now requires one canonical ACAD_RENDER_PLOT_SETTINGS entry, exactly one dictionary record with that handle owned by the actual NOD, and no differently named NOD alias to the same handle.

Extended the existing generated RenderSettings ASCII/Binary callback control with same-dictionary alias refusal, seeded destination preservation, corrected same-adapter retry, and strict readback for RapidRT and MentalRay.
